description: A pride-themed shared idea whiteboard. Start a board for the room, invite phones with a QR code, and let everyone add sticky notes and hearts in real time. Boards close 24 hours after they start; there is no login and nothing is saved long-term.
name: Queerboard

skills.description: Open https://mikedemo.one/ and choose 'Start a new board' to create a board for the room. You get a short room code and a QR code to display so others can join from their phones. The board lives at https://mikedemo.one/b/<CODE>.
skills.name: Start a board

skills.description: Open https://mikedemo.one/, enter the room code shown on the room screen, and join the live board — or scan the room's QR code. The board URL is https://mikedemo.one/b/<CODE>.
skills.name: Join a board

skills.description: Boards stay live for 24 hours after they start, then close on their own. While live, anyone who joined can add sticky notes, drag them around, and vote with hearts — everything appears in real time. There is no login and nothing is saved long-term.
skills.name: How boards work
